title: Hao on Na`Vi´s fountain hooks (Chinese) - The International 2013
description:
Mr Blue from joinDOTA interviewed Hao from TongFu who talks about the fountain hook strategy that Na`Vi had used to push them into the lower bracket. For all non-Chinese speaking fans, here is as always a translated version over on joinDOTA: [url=http://www.joindota.com/en/redirect/173][img align=center src=24565.png][/img][/url]

Anyone who wants to follow the event via liveticker can now download Razer Comms and join the Team Razer group. Just go to [url="http://www.razerzone.com/comms"]www.razerzone.com/comms[/url] to download and install this brilliant piece of VoIP tool and enter the following code "[color=#ccaa77][b]UXDUPzXXYuiQbm7O[/b][/color]" in the search.
